versions.content: Inclusion graph for FMFeatureSelectionSet s Let ⌊ S 1 ; S 2 ; : : : ; S n g be the set of all FMFeatureSelectionSet s in an AUTOSAR model. Then the inclusion graph for all FMFeatureSelectionSet s is a graph G = ( V; E ) where V = ⌊ S 1 ; S 2 ; : : : ; S n g E = ⌊ ( S i ; S j ) j S i refers to S j in the role include g
